newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher, boosted by drug, oil shares.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher, boosted by drug, oil shares.

text.p: British stocks closed mostly higher on Friday, propelled by strong drug and oil stocks but dragged off the day's highs by a weak Wall Street opening.

The FTSE 100 index ended 13.2 points up at 3,946.4 with gainers nearly matching decliners 49 to 46. Zeneca powered a rally in drug stocks after U.S. approval for an asthma treatment while Enterprise led a rise in heavily-weighted oil stocks.

Firm gilts helped support shares through much of the session yet a weak Dow opening -- down five points as London closed -- dragged the FTSE off its highs, with strategists saying Wall Street was showing signs of concern about slowing profit growth.
